newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower on improved conditions.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower on improved conditions.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled lower on an improving outlook for the crop, traders said. March set a new contract low at $3.61 before settling at $3.61-1/2.

"In general, the perception is that the situation is improving," a MGE trader said. "It looks like they got some rain yesterday and today and they're going to get some more rain this weekend up in North Dakota.
Traders said optimism about the new crop forced carries to widen out. The MGE September/March spring wheat carry widened to 15 cents a bushel Monday from eight cents last week.
"Probably the biggest thing today other than prices continuing to decline was that the carries widened out," the trader said.
Weakness in new crop CBOT soybeans and corn values weighed on wheat in mostly thin dealings. Light hedge-related selling was also noted in spring wheat.
The MGE estimated spring wheat futures volume at 20.097 million bushels.
Spring wheat settled two to 6-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with July down six cents at $3.59. New crop September lost 6-3/4 cents to close at $3.46-1/2.
